text: Hey Stav - you are doing the partner-visa process right? Do you have an appointment for the next interview yet? In any case, you should email your branch today and tell them she has arrived 🥳 Then in a couple of weeks you can go physically to the PIBA office to request an extension of the tourist visa based on the fact that she has a partner-visa application pending: https://aic.org.il/contact-details-and-information-about-visa-departments-of-piba/. You should arrive early, before 7.30 am ideally. You can also make sure they give you an appointment for the next stage if they haven't already.
